scripts.build: esbuild editor-src/editor.jsx --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=RichEditor --jsx=automatic --conditions=style --outfile=editor.bundle.js && esbuild editor-src/zola-builder.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=ZolaBuilder --outfile=zola-builder.bundle.js && esbuild editor-src/code-editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=CodeEditor --outfile=code-editor.bundle.js && node scripts/build-html.mjs
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml down -v --remove-orphans; docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml up -d && node e2e/seed.mjs
scripts.e2e:test: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:up && npm run e2e:test; status=$?; npm run e2e:down; exit $status
scripts.e2e:gitlab:up: docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.gitlab.yml down -v --remove-orphans; docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.gitlab.yml up -d && node e2e/seed-gitlab.mjs
scripts.e2e:gitlab:test: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.gitlab.config.mjs
scripts.e2e:gitlab: npm run e2e:gitlab:up && npm run e2e:gitlab:test; status=$?; npm run e2e:gitlab:down; exit $status
